name: clarify-first
conclusion: clarify-first (Ask) specifies 2 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 3 clarification rules; none for approval gates, validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: asking more questions once answered.

statements.quote: **Once answered, proceed confidently.** Use the answers to complete the task without asking more questions unless something truly unexpected comes up.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 3 clarification rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: clarifying questions before any work; waiting for answers before producing output.

statements.quote: Before doing any work on the user's task, ask targeted clarifying questions.
**Ask 3–6 focused questions.** Cover the most important unknowns — things that would meaningfully change your approach or output. Don't ask about things you can reasonably infer.
**Wait for answers before proceeding.** Do not produce any draft output, code, or plan alongside the questions. Questions only.
